scope: finish calibration on original compositions; not new-character continuity validation

trials.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / controlled animation-frame finish calibration.
The single supplied image is the exact SCENE, IDENTITY, STYLE, LIGHT and CAMERA control, not a loose inspiration. Recreate the same defensive close medium shot of the red-haired human warrior in lavender steel armor with broad gold-trimmed pauldrons, behind the large pale shield bearing its black curved emblem. Preserve the specific angular face, hair mass, tense expression, shield geometry and foreground scale, sword and arm placement, blue-gray snowy rocky background, drifting snow, muted cold lighting, shadows, framing and perspective.
Change ONLY the capture finish described below. All content, design, pose, composition, colors, lighting, shadow geometry and proportions must remain as close as possible to the reference. This is a comparison study, not a redesign or an adjacent moment.
FINISH: Use a SUBTLE capture finish: very fine barely visible luminance grain and slightly softened line edges. The image is a little cleaner and less soft than the reference, but still a genuine-looking captured animation frame. Preserve broad flat shadow shapes. Never make vector-sharp contours, photographic skin or hyper-detailed material textures.
RENDERING INVARIANTS: angular 2D character drawing; clean but gently softened dark outlines; few broad hard-edged cel-shadow shapes; large hair locks and armor plates; layered painted background. The only desired differences between calibration variants are grain and edge softness. Do not add objects, characters, decorative runes, jewelry, particles, lens flares, cosmetic highlights or glossy 3D modeling. Preserve the original low-light exposure when present. No loading icons, playback UI, captions, labels or text. Keep the original wide approximately 2.4:1 picture composition, without adding black letterbox bars. Return ONE image.
